metrics.per_row_axes: voznativa.benchmark.outcome_axes: delivery, semantic_safety, task (by case kind), destination, regional, evaluation, human_preference, invariants (only where an output exists), quality, cost, latency

regional forms or E0 markers added without a licensing activation
metrics.llm_judge: same judge prompt for every changed output, kind=llm, separate call
metrics.uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval of task met-or-pending per arm; n = 19 per arm is not enough for general estimates
